meta.name: business-case
meta.description: Develop a business case for an initiative using costs, benefits, risks and evidence. Use when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一项计划的成本、收益与风险整理成能说服赞助方的商业论证。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在评审会上为一项计划争取经费或排期,却还没讲清投入产出。
copy.tagline_en: Turn an initiative's costs, benefits, and risks into a clear case sponsors will back.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must justify budget or timeline for an initiative to a sponsor.

howto.what: Claude 会为某项计划撰写商业论证，梳理成本、收益、风险与支撑证据，供申请预算或时间线时使用。它会先读任务上下文约定和方法，再按需加载其他参考。
howto.when: 当发起人需要预算或时间线依据时触发。若由 @fde 调用，则复用其已有的已清理数据包和范围，不重新开始设定或提问。

say.text: 帮我为这个项目写一份商业论证，列出成本、收益和风险
say.note: 会先读任务上下文约定和方法再产出

say.text: 我要向发起人申请预算，帮我把成本收益和证据整理成论证
say.note: 按方法组织成本、收益与证据

say.text: 给这个方案做时间线论证，说明风险和支撑证据
say.note: 输出面向时间线审批的论证

howto.what_en: Claude drafts a business case for an initiative: costs, benefits, risks and evidence, for budget or timeline approval. It reads the task context contract and method first, loading more references only as needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a sponsor needs budget or timeline justification. If called by @fde, it reuses that existing sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup or questions.

say_en.text: Write a business case for this project with costs, benefits and risks
say_en.note: Reads the context contract and method first

say_en.text: I need sponsor budget approval — turn costs, benefits and evidence into a case
say_en.note: Organizes costs, benefits and evidence by the method

say_en.text: Build a timeline case for this option, covering risks and supporting evidence
say_en.note: Outputs a case aimed at timeline approval
